title: Nowcasting aerosol particle size distributions from PM2.5 with physics-regularized flow matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.33557v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The mass concentration of particles smaller than 2.5um (PM2.5) is cheap to measure and widely monitored, whereas the particle number size distribution (PSD) requires costly instruments and is measured at only a few research stations. Yet many aerosol effects, such as vapor uptake, cloud droplet formation and deposition in the human respiratory tract, depend on the PSD rather than on mass. We explore whether recent generative deep learning models can nowcast the PSD: from the PM2.5 record and eight meteorological parameters over a 24h window, a model generates an ensemble of plausible hourly size distributions for the same window, reflecting that one mass can arise from many size distributions. Rather than proposing a single best model, we use two contrasting Finnish stations, the boreal forest site Hyyti\"al\"a and the urban site Kumpula, as a controlled testbed. translated_title: 利用物理正则化流匹配从PM2.5即时预报气溶胶粒径分布
translated_abstract: 小于2.5微米颗粒物的质量浓度（PM2.5）测量成本低且监测范围广，而颗粒物数浓度粒径分布（PSD）则需要昂贵的仪器，且仅在少数研究站点进行测量。然而，许多气溶胶效应，如蒸汽吸收、云滴形成以及在人体呼吸道中的沉积，取决于粒径分布而非质量。我们探索了近期的生成式深度学习模型能否对粒径分布进行即时预报：在24小时窗口内，模型根据PM2.5记录和八个气象参数，生成该窗口内一组合理的小时级粒径分布集合，反映出同一质量浓度可能对应多种不同的粒径分布。我们没有提出单一的最佳模型，而是使用两个特征迥异的芬兰站点——北方森林站点Hyytiälä和城市站点Kumpula——作为受控测试平台，并在该平台上将六种生成模型与确定性和气候学基线进行基准比较。
tldr: 本文提出利用物理正则化流匹配的生成式深度学习方法，仅从PM2.5质量浓度和气象参数即时生成气溶胶粒径分布的合理集合，并以芬兰森林和城市两个对比站点为测试平台，对六种生成模型进行了系统性基准评测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes physics-regularized flow matching to nowcast aerosol particle size distributions from PM2.5 and meteorological data, benchmarking six generative models across two contrasting Finnish stations as a controlled testbed.
